⏱️ Timeline Comparison: The TikTok vs Facebook Collapse (2016–2025)

📌 What you’ll see:
A chart-race of ad-revenue gravity shifting in the TikTok era—Meta’s massive scale meets rising competition, while TikTok ramps from near-zero into a major global money machine.

instagram_caption:
🚀 Facebook didn’t fall overnight—TikTok just kept taking the scroll.

In 2016, Meta (Facebook) was already a billboard empire: roughly **$26.9B** in revenue. Then 2017 added fuel with **$34.3B**. Meanwhile, the “TikTok era” hadn’t really become a monetization story yet—short-form was still mostly a taste, not a budget line.

By 2018, the numbers start to matter for the first time. Meta hit **$55.8B**, but TikTok/ByteDance was still around **$3.0B**—tiny compared to Meta’s scale. The turning point wasn’t just growth; it was timing: TikTok’s algorithm + creator flywheel arrived as users increasingly wanted entertainment-first feeds, not community-first posting.

Then 2020 changed everything. During the pandemic, attention became a scarce asset—and TikTok converted it. Meta climbed to **$84.2B**, but TikTok jumped to **$14.0B**. In 2021, the gap widened: Meta did **$114.9B**, while TikTok surged to **$27.5B**. Meta remained dominant, yet TikTok began to look like the future of digital discovery and youth engagement.

By 2022–2023, the competitive pressure became impossible to ignore. Meta sat at **$116.6B** (2022) then **$134.9B** (2023), but TikTok accelerated harder: **$45.0B** (2022) → **$72.0B** (2023). In 2024, TikTok’s monetization went full throttle (**$120.0B**) while Meta pushed even higher (**$163.5B**). In 2025, Meta ends near **$160.0B**, while TikTok reaches an estimated **$150.0B**—closing fast.

🎯 So here’s the question: Do you think TikTok will fully dethrone Meta in ad revenue next—or will Meta’s scale and targeting keep it in the crown position?

Follow for more timeline chart-races, and subscribe so you don’t miss the next showdown.

Meta vs TikTok… and it’s way more dramatic than it sounds. 📱

2016: Meta around **$26.9B**.
2018: Meta **$55.8B**, TikTok starts getting monetization traction at ~**$3.0B**.
2020: Meta **$84.2B**, TikTok jumps to **$14.0B**.
2025: Meta ~**$160B**, TikTok ~**$150B**.

The crazy part? Meta didn’t “collapse”—it just got challenged hard as attention shifted to short-form.

Do you think TikTok overtakes Meta next in ad revenue, or does Meta’s targeting keep them on top?
